description: This Java class 'ConfigUtil' provides utility methods for accessing and managing configuration properties within the OpenMRS system, including global, runtime, and system properties, with caching and change notification support.

classes.name: ConfigUtil
classes.description: A utility class for working with configuration properties in OpenMRS, supporting global, runtime, and system properties with cache management and change listeners.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the specified global property value, utilizing an internal cache to optimize repeated lookups.

methods.name: getRuntimeProperty
methods.description: Returns the value of a runtime property for the given property name.

methods.name: hasRuntimeProperty
methods.description: Checks whether a runtime property with the specified name exists.

methods.name: getSystemProperty
methods.description: Returns the value of a system property for the given name.

methods.name: hasSystemProperty
methods.description: Checks whether a system property with the specified name exists.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration property value, checking system, runtime, then global properties in order of precedence.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration property value with a default fallback if the property is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Callback method triggered when a global property changes; updates the cache accordingly.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Callback method triggered when a global property is deleted; removes the entry from cache.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Indicates support for any property name (always returns true).
